headline: Nigerian Startup Funding Drops 97% in September to $11.3 Million
summary: Venture capital funding for Nigerian startups plunged by 96.9% month-on-month in September to $11.3 million across nine companies, down sharply from $364.1 million secured by 20 firms in August.
why: Nigeria is one of Africa's primary venture tech hubs; a sharp pullback in early-stage financing affects technology hiring and fintech innovation.

impacts.name: Nigerian Startups
impacts.why: A 96.9% drop in monthly funding constrains working capital and runway across the venture ecosystem.
